message: P1 correction required: independent frozen review bc0aeacd36df40b591f53c44d3b9a4fd = ChangesRequested. A new STOP alert queued after a job completed but before GetJobResult polling gets CAS-consumed then silently dropped because server substitutes original ToolResponse and discards poll-time instructions. Read review finding findings/completed-job-poll-drops-alert.md. Fix response guidance merge for completed job with non-null ToolResponse (preserve original job result plus latest alert instructions and any duration guidance), test it end-to-end including error/pending outcomes and no extra attributed activity, run .NET11 Release, request new frozen review. Do not deploy, merge or widen scope.
